Section 1

Review from last time
Linear Regression with One Variable

  • Predict Y on a single variable X

Y ≈β0 + β1X
  • Find good guesses for β^0, β^1.
  • ŷi = β^0 + β^1xi
  • ei = yi −ŷi is the ith residual
  • residual sum of squares RSS = ∑ ⁡ iei2

    • RSS is minimized at least squares coefficient estimates

      β^1 = ∑ i=1n(xi −x¯)(yi −y¯) ∑ i=1n(xi −x¯)2 β^0 = y¯ −β^1x¯
    Evaluating the model

    • Linear regression is unbiased

    • Variance of linear regression estimates:

      SE(β^0) = σ2 [1 n + x¯2 ∑ i=1n(xi −x¯)2 ] SE(β^1)2 = σ2 ∑ i=1n(xi −x¯)2

      where σ2 = Var(𝜀)

    • Estimate σ: σ^2 = 𝑅𝑆𝑆 n−2

    • The 95% confidence interval for β1 approximately takes the form

    β^1 ± 2 ⋅SE(β^1)

  • Hypothesis test:

    • β1 = 0
    • β1≠0
    • Test statistic t = β^1−0 SE(β^1)
    • Assessing the accuracy of the model

    Residual standard error (RSE): 𝑅𝑆𝐸 = 1 n − 2𝑅𝑆𝑆

    R squared:

    R2 = 𝑇𝑆𝑆 −𝑅𝑆𝑆 𝑇𝑆𝑆 = 1 −𝑅𝑆𝑆 𝑇𝑆𝑆
    𝑇𝑆𝑆 = ∑ i(yi −y¯)2

    Section 2

    Multiple Linear Regression
    Setup

    Y = β0 + β1X1 + β2X2 + ⋯βpXp + 𝜀
    Estimation and Prediction

    Given estimates β^0,β^1,β^2,⋯,β^p, prediction is
    ŷ = β^0 + β^1x1 + ⋯ + β^pxp
    Minimize the sum of squares 𝑅𝑆𝑆 = ∑ i(yi −ŷi)2 = ∑ i(yi −β^0 −β^1xi1 −⋯ −β^px𝑖𝑝)2

    Coefficients are closed form but UGLY

    Advertising data set example

    𝚂𝚊𝚕𝚎𝚜 = β0 + β1 ⋅𝚃𝚅 + β2 ⋅𝚛𝚊𝚍𝚒𝚘 + β3 ⋅𝚗𝚎𝚠𝚜𝚙𝚊𝚙𝚎𝚛

    Interpretation of coefficients

    𝚂𝚊𝚕𝚎𝚜 = β0 + β1 ⋅𝚃𝚅 + β2 ⋅𝚛𝚊𝚍𝚒𝚘 + β3 ⋅𝚗𝚎𝚠𝚜𝚙𝚊𝚙𝚎𝚛

    Section 3

    Ch 3.2.2: Questions to ask of your regression
    Question 1
    Is at least one of the predictors X1,⋯,Xp
    useful in predicting the response?
    Q1: Hypothesis test

    • β1 = β2 = ⋯ = βp = 0
    • At least one βj is non-zero

    F-statistic:

    F = (𝑇𝑆𝑆 −𝑅𝑆𝑆)∕p 𝑅𝑆𝑆∕(n −p − 1) ∼Fp,n−p−1
    The F-statistic for the hypothesis test

    F = (𝑇𝑆𝑆 −𝑅𝑆𝑆)∕p 𝑅𝑆𝑆∕(n −p − 1) ∼Fp,n−p−1
